svg.title: L compilation pipeline with App processes light
svg.desc: L source with explicit imports is analyzed by Lyger, emitted as AML structured markup, and converted by Logeme to Rust source bundles. The CLI coordinates a Cargo workspace that builds a native orchestrator, App binaries and App-owned Service libraries on the current macOS or Linux host. Apps run as separate processes. Standalone Service declarations create no build artifact.

g.data-label: Go-based tooling. Generated Rust. Explicit build artifacts.

text.data-label: Standalone Service declarations create no build artifact.
